_doc: AL2 structural-complexity diagnostic (decisions.md §21). Same pilot as configs/gen/al1_pilot.json over n = 8..20, 10 solvable documents per size. --archetype tree: the frozen training cohort documents (training seeds only). --archetype chain: documents generated as N4 does, namespace al2-chain, training's exclusions, solvable ones kept. M0 = the document itself; the same documents go through every (mechanism set, level).

decision_rule._doc: Fixed 18 Nov 2026 before any AL2 run; never tuned after one. Binding on the chain run only: go (build the AL3 diversified multi-role archetype) iff, for config all|medium, at least one any_of bound holds and every all_of bound holds; otherwise stop (keep the frozen null). Bounds are inclusive lower bounds; a missing metric fails.
